text: Section 103-8.7 D. of the City of Toronto Municipal Code requires the Chief Planner to prepare a report for information to City Council on the properties included in the Heritage Register in 2023 as listed properties through the delegated authority of the Chief Planner. This report also reviews the performance and process of administering the delegated authority of including properties in the Heritage Register. In 2023, six properties on three development sites were listed in the Heritage Register using the Chief Planner's delegated authority. One property municipally known as 409 Huron Street has been designated under Section 29 of the Ontario Heritage Act (OHA).
